verdict.rationale: Graphite Agent automatically reviews every new pull request across selected repos or a whole organization, with no configuration required. The pricing page lists unlimited AI reviews, and teams can add custom rules, comment exclusions and metrics on issues found and acceptance rates, so it can review PRs at volume. GT MCP also splits large AI-generated changes into smaller reviewable stacks, and Graphite's own Agents open draft PRs for review. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence that review quality holds up on agent-authored code at scale, evidence that the reviewer can block or gate merges rather than only comment, and anything showing it handles agent-authored PRs differently from human ones.
